stem: A square photo with side length \(s\) inches is placed in a frame that adds a border 2 inches wide on every side. The framed photo is a square with an area of 100 square inches. What is the value of \(s\)?
solution: The border adds 2 inches on each of two opposite sides, so the framed side length is \(s + 4\).
Set up the equation: \((s + 4)^{2} = 100\), so \(s + 4 = 10\) (a length is positive).
verify:
s = symbols('s', positive=True)
sol = solve(Eq((s + 4)**2, 100), s)
assert sol == [6]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == sol
